notes.title: Patch 1 Live
notes.notes:
This our first patch since the launch.
After the feedback we've received, we rebalanced some enemies in early levels to make the puzzles easier.
We've also fixed some small dialogue errors and texture glitches on multiple maps.
Added missing car animations to Budapest environments and removed camera movements that glitch the level introductions.

Thank you for your support! Feel free to post any issues you encounter in the game.

notes.title: Follow The Crown is LIVE!
notes.notes:
